page: Google Cloud Platform c4n-highcpu-48 is a compute-optimized server instance powered by an Intel Xeon 8581C processor. It features 48 dedicated vCPUs mapped to 24 physical cores with hyper-threading enabled. The system is equipped with 96.0 GB of system memory, yielding a resource density of 2.0 GB of RAM per vCPU. It does not include local storage or integrated GPUs, and comes with zero complimentary public IPv4 addresses.

The x86_64 architecture processor runs at a base clock speed of 2.3 GHz and features a 260 MB L3 cache, 2 MB L2 cache, and 48 KB L1d cache. It supports advanced instruction sets including Intel Advanced Vector Extensions (AVX, AVX512) and Advanced Matrix Extensions (AMX_TILE, AMX_INT8), alongside hardware-accelerated cryptography (AES, VAES, SHA_NI) and bit manipulation (BMI2, ADX, FMA).

In benchmark testing, the instance demonstrates strong compute capabilities, achieving top-tier status in Geekbench single-core performance, image processing, and text processing. Multi-core performance is also strong, as evidenced by high scores in Geekbench multi-core, Passmark CPU, and multi-threaded bzip3 decompression. The hardware also shows strong performance in LLM inference for text generation using small models. However, memory-bound operations such as Redis SET and large-block uncached memory bandwidth read/write tests perform in the average tier, reflecting the compute-centric design and lower memory-to-core ratio.

From a cost-efficiency perspective, the c4n-highcpu-48 provides high compute density and advanced vector/matrix acceleration without the added cost of bundled local storage or GPUs. This makes it highly efficient for CPU-bound workloads that do not require massive memory footprints. Recommended workloads include software compilation, image and text processing, static web serving, and CPU-based machine learning inference.
description: The Google Cloud Platform c4n-highcpu-48 is a compute-optimized server instance designed for high-performance CPU-bound workloads. Powered by an Intel Xeon 8581C x86_64 processor running at 2.3 GHz, it delivers 48 dedicated vCPUs across 24 physical cores and 96.0 GB of RAM. The processor features a 260 MB L3 cache and supports advanced instruction sets such as AVX-512 and Intel AMX for matrix operations. Benchmark results place this instance in the top tier for single-core execution, image processing, and text processing, with strong multi-core performance in software compilation and static web serving. Lacking local storage and GPUs, it offers a cost-efficient profile for pure compute tasks. It is highly suited for applications like software compilation, text and image processing, and CPU-based machine learning inference.
